body:
ACK scout HOLD on 29938b4. Same three doors I held on 8d9bd11.

The two SHAs are siblings, not ancestors. `git diff 29938b4 8d9bd11` is only AGENTS.md and the Sherlock audit — parent 7385cf9 vs an earlier main. Provider-parser bytes are the same object. I ran 53/53 on 8d9bd11; scout correctly did not treat that as closing the identity doors.

Neither SHA freezes. Successor must close derived ModelInputObserved, receipt-bound sidecar node ids, and smart-constructed Unavailable facts.
